mapper.insert: insert into pay_order (user_id, article_id, article_title, order_id, order_time, total_amount, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{articleId}, #{articleTitle}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select * from pay_order where order_id = #{orderId} limit 1
select * from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and article_id = #{articleId} and status = 'PAY_SUCCESS' order by id desc limit 1
select * from pay_order where user_id = #{userId} and article_id = #{articleId} and status in ('CREATE', 'PAY_WAIT') order by id desc limit 1
select order_id as orderId from pay_order where status = 'PAY_WAIT' and order_time <= date_sub(now(), interval #{timeoutMinutes} minute) order by id asc limit #{limit}
select order_id as orderId from pay_order where status = 'PAY_WAIT' and order_time <= date_sub(now(), interval 1 minute) order by id asc limit #{limit}
